description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping them, adding {U}{R}{R}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
